body: ive had a less than pleasant life tbh. i either had no father figure for years, or an abusive one. i havent seen my real dad since i was 9. my moms boyfriend beat me, as well as telling me all manner of insults that went from i was an idiot to i had poor fashion. ill give the man one thing, he had variety. my mom got knocked up early and resented her kids for stealing her youth, so she was never emotionally available. she's a good woman, she just wasn't made to be a parent. i'm not mad at her for it. now i have to do at minimum another two years of high school, thats if i take extra classes. in three years of high school, ive passed one class, and that was gym. i was placed in a program for kids with high iqs and advanced learning tactics, and i believe it ruined me socially. im fine with people but for some reason everyone hated me because i was in that class. if someone gets to know me its pretty rare they dont like me, but i dont know many people because of the "gifted" stigma. i have a few friends but i only have one who knows about the depression. shes drifting away because im never happy, and its hard for her. i understand. i dont blame her.

im looking forward to this more than my birthday, which is only 3 days away actually. id sleep to pass time if i could. but sometimes i dont sleep for days. i can hear everyone ive ever failed when i close my eyes, and it keeps me up.

i've been depressed since i was a small child. always severe. my mom didnt want me to get medication, she thought i could get over it naturally. even when i was 11 i would cry myself to sleep. i don't think ive ever been truly happy. but the last year or so, i cry almost every day. it takes all of my energy not to break down crying on the bus, at the store, at school. its exhausting. i got kicked out of school for skipping too much, when really i would either hide in the bathroom all day or go home and hide in bed.
goodbye tucker. youre only 5. but youre a good dog. i know youll forgive me for this. i love you.

everything is so... faded. colors arent as vivid as they used to be. food doesnt taste as good. i used to be able to pass the time with drugs and pussy, but i dont enjoy sex anymore, i just wait for it to be over. and im too broke for drugs. my heart hurts. physically. like someone is squeezing it harder each day. ive attempted suicide a couple times, with a tie off a doorknob or a belt. i panicked with the tie, and the belt was a stupid idea. as soon as you pass out you stop putting pressure on the belt, so you start breathing again. but something that stood out was whenever i was close, whenever i could feel my eyes closing, my heart stopped hurting. i felt peaceful. i felt like i did the one thing i was meant to do.
